title.romaji: Campione!: Matsurowanu Kamigami to Kamigoroshi no Maou
title.native: カンピオーネ！ ～まつろわぬ神々と神殺しの魔王～

description:
Some people suddenly find religion, but for 16-year-old Kusanagi GoDo, it's that REALLY old time religion that's found him! As the result of defeating the God of War in mortal combat, GoDo's stuck with the unwanted position of Campione!, or God Slayer, whose duty is to fight Herectical Gods whenever they try to muscle in on the local turf. Not only is this likely to make GoDo roadkill on the Highway to Heaven, it's also a job that comes with a lot of other problems. Like how to deal with the fact that his "enhanced status" is attracting a bevy of overly-worshippy female followers. After all, they're just there to aid him in his demi-godly duties, right? So why is it that their leader, the demonically manipulative sword-mistress Erica Brandelli, seems to have such a devilish interest in encouraging some VERY unorthodox activities?

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name.native: エリカ・ブランデッリ

node.description: A member of 'Copper Black Cross' - a magician organization based in Milan.  Holding the rank of Great Knight and the title of Diavolo Rosso she is a magic swordsmen that through coincidence meets Godou and assists him while he is in Sardinia.  Using her weapon Cuore de Leone an enchanted weapon summoned by her known as the king of lions.  Originally wary of Godou however becomes attached to him. Her personality likes to keep herself in control of her own situation thus she can be very forceful in her affection however she truly cares for Godou. Even allowing for other women to love him on the condition that in Godous heart SHE is always No. 1.  She sleeps naked and she also refers to herself as the "Red Devil."

name.native: リリアナ・クラニチャール

node.description: A member of "Bronze Black Cross," a magician organization based in Milan. Known as Erica's rival, she also holds the rank of Great Knight. Wielding her sword Il Maestro, her swordsmanship is on par with Erica; however, her true strength lies in Witchcraft.  She has fairy-like beauty and a strong sense of duty. She falls for Godou and swears as a knight she will serve him for eternity. She also like to write romance novels in secret (though Erica knows and constantly blackmails her with them).  Liliana was a member of the magical association descended from the Knights Templar called Bronze-Black Cross, and a childhood friend and rival of Erica's, the pair having met at the age of two, and both of them earning their knighthood at the age of twelve. As part of the tradition, shortly after earning their knighthood, both traveled to gain Magic swords for themselves at the Saint Gilardino Monastery outside of Florence, Italy. There, they first encountered Salvatore Doni, just after he had become a Campione. While traveling with him, they encountered the retired Great Knight Saint Raffaello, the only knight to gain two swords from the Monastery, and one of Doni's teachers.

The main character of the series and one of only 7 Campione. Originally a retired middle school baseball player, after his grandfather asked him to return a stone tablet to a friend in Sardinia named Lucretia Zola a series of events take place in which he kills the god Verethragna, a Persian god of Victory. Due to a curse, any god killed by a mortal, that mortal shall obtain the abilities of the killed god. These are the people known as Campione.  Godou obtains the abilities of Verethragna's 10 forms: The Wind, Bull, White Stallion, Camel, Boar, The Youth, Raptor, Ram, Goat and The Warrior.  Each of these forms give Godou a different ability; however each also has a condition for activation.  He's very uncomfortable with having Erica, Yuri and Liliana competing for his affection and even tries to distance himself from them, even though having a harem is one of the Campione's privilege.

The goddess of wisdom in Greek Mythology and the daughter of Zeus.  She is in fact a snake deity associated with Medusa and an Earth and Death Goddess.  Athena appears like a little girl due to being incomplete and seeks the Gorgoneion to complete herself and plunge the world into eternal darkness.

A part of the Japanese Magician's Society (History Compilation Committee) in an elite group known as the Hime-Miko. A miko with a strong Spirit Vision which allows her to obtain visions from objects.  Originallly fearful of Godou due to her previous encounter with the Campione Marquis Voban. She later opens up to and falls for him, becoming one of his allies.  Touma, her guardian often calls her "Princess."

Ena has a very strange personality in that she seems relaxed about things of the modern world, but still has a slight naivite about her. She the type of person who acts on impulse and instinct, rather than her wits.  Also a Hime-Miko like Yuri. She however is also a swordsman like Erica and Lily. Her specialty lies in Divine Possession, a skill allowing her body to be empowered by spirits or gods. The sword she carries, the Ama no Murakumo no Tsurugi, a sword more commonly known as the Kusunagi sword, is famous for being wielded by the god Susanoo and slaying the Yamata no Orochi. By borrowing power from it she can become very strong; however, a danger is that her spirit may be completely taken if the Divine Possession is too strong.

Lucretia appears to be a playful sort, given to pranks of various kinds, though she appears willing to help people out when needed. She calls herself Godou's 'foreign wife,' but that appears more to be a joke than any actual romantic interest in Godou.  (Source: Campione! Wiki)

name.native: カレン・ヤンクロフスキ

node.description: Karen has a similar devilish personality as Erica Blandelli as well as being a very intelligent young lady.  It was stated in the Novel, that Karen already graduated from High School and is currently an apprentice Witch studying at the Kranjcar family's Bronze-Black Cross magic association. She is now working besides Liliana, receiving an education necessary to be a Witch.   (Source: Campione! Wiki)

Godou's little sister, who is in her 3rd year of middle school. Also a member of the Tea Ceremony Club along with Yuri.  Worried that her brother is becoming like their grandfather (a natural player), she is very strict with him to try prevent this. However it is also suggested that her being strict with her brother is actually a cover up for her jealousy as she may have a brother complex with Godou.

name.native: アリアンナ・ハヤマ・アリアルディ

node.description: Being Erica's maid, Arianna is very skilled in just about all forms of house-keeping and serving, though she is horrible at making soups or stews. She has also shown herself to be a terrible or reckless driver.  (Source: Campione! Wiki)

A goddess with pink hair tied in twintails and wears a white dress. She appears occasionally in Godou's dreams when he is in the border of life and death after the Ram Authority has been activated.    ~!She is considered to be the 'mother' of all Campiones due to being the source of the curse for the transformation of a normal human to a Campione. She and his husband Epimetheus are the originators of the ritual that when a god has been defeated and sacrificed by a human, that human will absorb the god's powers and become a Campione.!~

Verethragna is a battle-loving god and is willing to do anything to find a worthy opponent. He even went as far as to revive Melqart just so that he could fight him. He further gave one of his incarnation to Godou to test him and strengthen his opposition.
Hikari Miariya is the younger sister of Yuri Mariya, and a Hime-Miko.

Formerly known as a failure of a Knight Templar, which requires one to know an adequate amount of magic and swordsman ship. Salvatore Doni has zero knowledge in magic or magic related knowledge even after he became the 6th Campione. He is known as “the strongest knight of Italy”. His lack of magical knowledge and skill, yet still being able to fight well enough to slay a Heretic God makes some call him a 'heretical genius.'

Metis is the mother and second personality of Athena.   ~!Without the full extent of her powers, Metis greatly resembles Athena, but with different colored cloths. She looks like a girl in her early teens with grey-white hair and purple eyes, dressed in a school uniform with a knit cap on her head.!~   ~!After absorbing Athena, she seemingly ages to her early twenties, and her clothing transforms into a Grecian toga, wearing a crown of flowers on her head, and wielding a scythe (although the colors of her cloths and eyes differ).!~   ~!Metis is a Snake (Earth Mother Goddess) who swallows Steel, allowing her to steal the power of Steel gods. For example, she was able to wield Ame no Murakumo no Tsurugi after stealing it. It is suggested that she wields all the powers of her daughter Athena.!~  (Source: Campione! Wikia)

A Heretic God of wind and thunder that Godou encountered during his trip to Italy in his spring break.  He was awakened by Verethragna in order to be defeated. He teamed up temporarily with Godou, who is using the Tome of Prometheus, to defeat the Persian warlord. After Godou defeated Verethragna and became a Campione, he announced that he will be his second opponent and will battle him once their wounds heal.

Susanoo is a former Heretic God. He seems rather mellow, as he even allows Ena to get away with calling him Grampsy, and asking Godou to call him Old Man. Still will not allow those who are not at least Campione, if not gods, to be in his presence.  (Source: Campione! Wiki)
He is a member of the Committee for the Compilation of True History and he is also Yuri's guardian.

name.native: サーシャ·デヤンスタール·ウォバン

node.description: Sasha Dejanstahl Voban is a Campione. He is very cold man who cares nothing for others, only desiring to battle worthy opponents (such as Heretic Gods) and gaining more Authorities. He is willing to kill anyone who gets in his way. Little is known about Voban's past, except that he killed a Heretic God as a young man, becoming a Campione, and is over three centuries old. Voban is not even his real name but a name he picked up for whatever reason soon after he became Campione three centuries ago.

Perseus is a Legendary Dragon Killer, a rouge god, the hero Perseus. He kills any dragons that he can find, not caring what the after math would be from destroying a dragon. According to him, slaying dragons is his duty. He rides on Pegasus. He uses a sword and a bow and arrow. He also posses the ability to seal the authorities of the god Verethragna.

Ama no Murakumo no Tsurugi (Sword of the Gathering Clouds of Heaven), also known as Kusanagi no Tsurugi (Grass-Cutting Sword), is a legendary black Japanese sword, and part of the Imperial Regalia of Japan. It was formerly the property of the former Heretic God Susanoo and considered a demigod.  Ama no Murakumo no Tsurugi is a demi-god of Steel and has shown the Authority of Wind control, and the ability to enhance the wielder to a point where they can surpass the abilities of a Great Knight. It can also possess its wielder when they are in the Netherworld. It's suggested that both of these require the power of Divine Possession to accomplish though.   ~!Since its introduction, Ama no Murakumo has revealed the ability to adsorb Authorities, whether those of its wielder Godou, or those of an attacker, to provide power, and transform them into new abilities. After absorbing the power of wind from the Authority of Luo Hao, it granted Godou the power of shockwaves from his punches, when adsorbing lightning created from Godou's Authority, it developed immense magnetic powers, and other abilities.!~ (Source: Campione! Wiki)
